scripts.build:darwin: npm run buildBinary:darwin && npm run esbuild
scripts.build-dev:darwin: npm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && npm run esbuild-dev && npm run build-types
scripts.buildBinary:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/MacFrontmostObserver' ]; then rm bin/MacFrontmostObserver; fi && swift build -c release --package-path src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver && cp src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver/.build/release/MacFrontmostObserver bin/MacFrontmostObserver
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/MacFrontmostObserver' ]; then rm bin/MacFrontmostObserver; fi && swift build -c debug --package-path src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver && cp src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver/.build/debug/MacFrontmostObserver bin/dev/MacFrontmostObserver
